name: Terrarium 11x15x20 with 3D Background
label: Small terrarium
lead: Compact 11x15x20 cm mini terrarium with a handmade polystyrene 3D background that faithfully imitates rock. Made of quality glass with decorative film in a natural wood tone, it is a perfect choice for keeping spiders and insects. The vertical format gives enough room for climbing and natural behavior.
imageAlt: Mini glass terrarium 11x15x20 cm with 3D background - NS Reptiles

description.html: This mini terrarium is handmade in our workshop in Novi Sad. It is built from quality 3 mm glass framed with wood-grain decorative film for a warm, rustic look. The back holds a hand-sculpted polystyrene 3D background that convincingly imitates a rock surface, creating a natural setting and extra climbing surfaces.
The top has plastic ventilation for airflow, plus an opening for equipment such as a mini lamp or a misting system. The floor is flat and suitable for any substrate you choose.

We build all our terrariums by hand, so you can customize the film color, 3D background style and extra equipment to your liking. If you need a different size or a specific add-on, feel free to contact us. We'll gladly build a terrarium to your measurements.
